description: This PHP class 'AccessEmployeeFileController' handles requests for accessing employee data files in JSON format within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It manages permissions, retrieves employee data via services, formats responses as JSON, and sets proper HTTP headers for file download.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling requests to access employee data files in JSON format, including permission checks, data retrieval, formatting, and response handling.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JsonDownloadFormat object used for JSON formatting.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceService object used to access employee data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes HTTP requests to retrieve employee data; performs permission check, fetches employee info, formats JSON response, and sets download headers. Returns a Response object or triggers a bad request response.
